parts.stem: **E** is made when a carboxylic acid and an alcohol react together.
parts.text: Name the type of reaction that takes place during this esterification reaction.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation for the formation of **E** from a carboxylic acid and an alcohol. Use structural formulae to represent the organic species.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: State the systematic name of the alcohol used to make **E**.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem:
**F** is an isomer of **E**.
**F** reacts with $\text{HCl(aq)}$ to produce **G** and **H**.
**G** is a secondary alcohol.
**H** is also produced when $\text{HCl(aq)}$ is added to $\text{CH}_3\text{CN}$.
parts.text: Construct an equation for the acid hydrolysis of $\text{CH}_3\text{CN}$ with $\text{HCl(aq)}$.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text:
$\text{CH}_3\text{OH}$ is used to make $\text{CH}_3\text{CN}$ in a two-step process, as shown in Fig. 4.2.
